name: AgentCard
summary: Who an agent is, what state it is in, and what it can do.

a11y.apg: none — it is a card, and the heading inside it carries the name

props.name: name
props.description: Required. Also feeds the avatar fallback, so a card never shows an empty circle.

props.name: description
props.description: One line about what the agent is for.

props.name: avatarSrc
props.description: Optional portrait; without it the initials stand in.

props.name: model
props.description: Which model is behind it, shown as secondary text. A string and not an enum: the list changes faster than this library ships.

props.name: state
props.description: Renders an AgentStatus in the header. Omit it and the header simply has no state.

props.name: capabilities
props.description: What the agent can do, as pills. `description` becomes the tooltip; the icon is optional.

props.name: actions
props.description: Your buttons, in the footer. The reference dispatches actions by STRING (`onAction(action: string)`), which trades the compiler for a verbal agreement — here whoever builds the button already knows what it does.
